# Ayush Nakade

- Role: Full Stack Developer (React, JavaScript, Node.js, REST APIs)

- Education: Information Technology degree, 2024–2028 (in progress)
- Certification: Full Stack Developer – Beginner (Level 1), Enjoy Programming, 15 June 2024 (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, manual testing)
- Shipped: 6 live client websites, 50+ practice projects
- Works with AI coding assistants for prototyping, debugging and review, and tests everything he ships
- Contact: ayushnakade18@gmail.com
